composition_notes: Seven eighth notes are grouped three-plus-two-plus-two, with an inner part phrased two-plus-two-plus-three.
The 3+2+2 and 2+2+3 opposition remains intact. The two inner lines now continue across the measure rather than restarting as chord blocks.
The score records each added suspension and scalar connection explicitly for teaching.
The free preludes are reviewed for note integrity, spelling, harmonic context and the listed voice-leading changes; they are not advertised as strict-species exercises.
